topic: A baking competition judge challenges a nervous contestant to name the dough technique behind a proper French croissant before scoring begins.
core_question: What type of dough, made by folding butter into layers of yeasted dough, is used to make a traditional French croissant?
answer_summary: Laminated dough (butter folded into layers of yeasted dough); 'puff pastry dough' accepted as a common variant.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there
